what: Two (or more) entrance panels stand side by side. Hovering a panel lifts the cover (contrast stage color 50%), a blurred photo·video (10px) becomes sharp and scales 1.04×, and the narrow panel takes --fx-open (original 20% → 66.4%) as its width and widens. The excess of the two widths’ sum is shrunk from both by their default width ratio (flex-shrink), so the original narrow panel goes 20% → about 45% and the wide one 80% → about 55%. The two lines of the panel name roll up 1.2em so the second line (English name) rises, the top-left dot shrinks to .66× while the ring circle spreads 2.3× (all .3s ease). The photo (zoom) slowly approaches 2× over 50 seconds while hovered. On phones (767px or less), pressing shows the opened state for 1 second before navigating — the ”Shop site / Brand site” fork on the company’s first page

options.--fx-w: Panel’s normal width (set via panel style), default 50%
options.--fx-open: Width on hover (set via the panel style), default is the normal width — original narrow panel 66.4%
options.--fx-gap: Gap between panels (set via panel group style), default 8px
options.--fx-veil · --fx-veil-alpha: Overlay color and opacity, default contrast stage color · .5
options.--fx-roll: Distance the name line rolls, default 1.2em
options.--fx-zoom · --fx-zoom-dur: zoom: scale and duration of the photo approaching, default 2 · 50s
options.tap: Time from press to moving on, on phones (ms), default 1000 — 0 moves on immediately
options.narrow: Width at which the press delay applies (px or less), default 767
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: One panel (link). Gives each panel --fx-w and --fx-open
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Photo or video filling the panel — starts blurred, then sharpens
options.[data-fx-part=zoom]: (Optional) photo that slowly moves closer while hovered — the img inside media
options.[data-fx-part=roll]: (optional) two-line overlapping name — the first and second children roll upward to swap
options.[data-fx-part=dot]: (Optional) accent color dot and ring at top left

use: Panel nameName…
note: Width switching happens only at 768px and up, like the original — on narrow screens the caller stacks the panels vertically and gives them a height. The phone press delay narrows the original (1s on every link at 767px and below) to links inside this panel group.

from.where: index.html sales and brand two-way panel (div.link-wrap a: dealer 80% · brand 20% → hover 66.4%, ::before #000 .5 → 0, img·video blur 10px → 0 · scale 1.04, img top-img 50s scale 1 → 2, span.inner ±1.2em, .dots scale .66 · ::after 2.3, all .3s; top.js tapping at 767px or below moves after 1000ms)
